cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

# Include definitions generated by QPM on restore
include(qpm_defines.cmake)
include(target.cmake)

project(${COMPILE_ID})

# C++ standard

if(
        (TARGET_GAME_VERSION STREQUAL "1_37_0") OR
        (TARGET_GAME_VERSION STREQUAL "1_40_8")
    )
    set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED 20)
else()
    set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 26)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED 26)
endif()
# Provide compile commands so they can be used for intellisense
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS TRUE)

# Set compiler options
set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION TRUE)
add_compile_options(-frtti -fexceptions -fvisibility=hidden -fvisibility-inlines-hidden -O3)

# Expose definitions from qpm_defines.cmake
add_compile_definitions(VERSION="${MOD_VERSION}")
add_compile_definitions(MOD_ID="${MOD_ID}")

add_compile_definitions("GAME_VER_${TARGET_GAME_VERSION}")
add_compile_definitions("GAME_VERSION=\"${TARGET_GAME_VERSION}\"")

# Add any extra definitions from the build script
get_cmake_property(variable_names VARIABLES)

foreach(variable_name ${variable_names})
    if(variable_name MATCHES "^_bs_build_def_.*$")
        string(SUBSTRING ${variable_name} 14 -1 definition_name)
        add_compile_definitions(${definition_name}=${${variable_name}})
        message("Added definition: " ${definition_name} "=" ${${variable_name}})
    endif()
endforeach()

# Trim source folder in logcat messages
string(LENGTH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/" FOLDER_LENGTH)
add_compile_definitions("PAPER_ROOT_FOLDER_LENGTH=${FOLDER_LENGTH}")

# Define the code directories
set(SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
set(INCLUDE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

# Recursively get all source files
recurse_files(cpp_file_list ${SOURCE_DIR}/*.cpp)
recurse_files(c_file_list ${SOURCE_DIR}/*.c)

# Add files used in beatsaber-hook's hooking library
recurse_files(inline_hook_c ${EXTERN_DIR}/includes/beatsaber-hook/shared/inline-hook/*.c)
recurse_files(inline_hook_cpp ${EXTERN_DIR}/includes/beatsaber-hook/shared/inline-hook/*.cpp)

# Add all source files to compilation
add_library(
    ${COMPILE_ID} SHARED ${cpp_file_list} ${c_file_list} ${inline_hook_cpp} ${inline_hook_c}
)

# Add include directories to compilation
target_include_directories(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE ${INCLUDE_DIR})

# Link necessary Android libraries
target_link_libraries(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE -llog -L${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/build/semver/aarch64-linux-android/release -lsemver_rustc)

# Add autogenerated definitions and link libraries for dependencies
include(extern.cmake)

add_custom_command(
    TARGET ${COMPILE_ID}
    POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "debug"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E rename "lib${COMPILE_ID}.so" "debug/lib${COMPILE_ID}.so"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_STRIP} -d --strip-all "debug/lib${COMPILE_ID}.so" -o "lib${COMPILE_ID}.so"
    COMMENT "Create stripped and debug libraries"
)

################# download embbed data #####################

set(EMBBED_DATA_CPP   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/EmbbedDataGenerated.cpp)

# On CI (GitHub Actions sets CI=true), a previous step downloads the data once and the same file is used in every build,
# so all game versions embed the same data. Don't download it again here.
set(IS_CI "$ENV{CI}")
if(IS_CI)
    if(NOT EXISTS ${EMBBED_DATA_CPP})
        message(FATAL_ERROR "CI build without EmbbedData, the workflow should provide ${EMBBED_DATA_CPP}")
    endif()
    message(STATUS "CI build, using provided EmbbedData: ${EMBBED_DATA_CPP}")
else()
    find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    add_custom_command(
            OUTPUT ${EMBBED_DATA_CPP}
            COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/download_translates.py ${EMBBED_DATA_CPP}
            DEPENDS
            COMMENT "Download EmbbedData"
            VERBATIM
    )
    add_custom_target(download_embbed_data DEPENDS ${EMBBED_DATA_CPP})
    add_dependencies(${COMPILE_ID} download_embbed_data)
endif()
target_sources(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE ${EMBBED_DATA_CPP})

############## end of download embbed data ################

include(${EXTERN_DIR}/includes/sslocalization/shared/utils/csv2hpp.cmake)
ssl10n_csv2hpp(${COMPILE_ID} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/SSL10nGenerated SSL10nGenerated.hpp "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/localize.csv")
